entries.label: Nuage fumigène dédié
entries.prompt: Create exactly ONE isolated static smoke-cloud visual effect asset on a genuinely transparent background for the Metal Gear fan fighting game CQC. The attached existing CQC atlas is a material/style reference ONLY: replace its chaff-shard cloud with a dedicated ordinary SMOKE grenade cloud. One single mid-expansion grounded cloud: dense soft grey-white billows, darker cool grey inside, thin wisps and semi-transparent feathered edges, broad oval silhouette, flat low baseline, contained entirely in frame with generous transparent margin on all sides. Match the realistically painted soft volume treatment of the reference atlas, but do NOT copy the atlas grid and do NOT include any metallic chaff particles, pebbles, debris, water splashes, missiles, sparks, flame, device or character. No shadow plane, no colored glow, no rectangle background, no checkerboard painted into the image, no text or labels. One cloud, one image, not a sequence. It should read clearly at small game scale as non-lethal screening smoke.

notes: Nuage ordinaire sans particules de chaff, fond transparent contrôlé.
Image statique de style CQC ; aucun frame canonique précis ni animation 1:1 revendiqués.
